reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "feat: Add AWSProvider.prefix to aws secrets manager by @justinwalz in https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4612", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A new optional AWS provider prefix field is added; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing configurations.

proposed.statement: A new optional prefix field was added to the AWS Secrets Manager provider of SecretStore/ClusterSecretStore (spec.provider.aws.prefix).
